description: Lay out a 52 or 53 week fiscal year as 12 periods in 4 quarters of 13 weeks. Send the first day of the fiscal year, the pattern ('4-4-5', '4-5-4' or '5-4-4' weeks in each quarter's three periods), and either weeks_in_year (52 or 53) or the 52-53-week year-end rule (year_end_month, year_end_weekday and year_end_rule 'nearest' or 'last'), from which the tool says whether this is the 53rd-week year. Get back every period's start date, end date, weeks, fiscal week numbers and quarter, the year-end date, the next year's start and whether a 53rd week was added. Send lookup_date to get its fiscal week, period and quarter. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/fiscal-calendar-weeks). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

fiscal_year_start.description: First day of the fiscal year, YYYY-MM-DD (the day after the previous year ended).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'FY2026' (your own text, echoed back).

lookup_date.description: Optional: a date to place in this fiscal year, YYYY-MM-DD.

pattern.description: Weeks in the three periods of each quarter: 4-4-5, 4-5-4 or 5-4-4.

weeks_in_year.description: 52 or 53. Send this or the year-end rule below, not both. Default 52 when neither is sent.

year_end_month.description: Month the year ends in, for the 52-53-week rule (1 to 12; 1 = January for the NRF retail year).

year_end_rule.description: nearest: ends on that weekday nearest the last day of the month (default). last: ends on the last such weekday in the month.

year_end_weekday.description: Weekday the year always ends on (the week's last day), e.g. Saturday. Needed with year_end_month.
